title: 21 October 2015: Ringo Starr live at Théâtre St-Denis, Montreal, Canada
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Théâtre Saint-Denis in Montreal, Canada, on 21 October 2015.

It was the 32nd show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North and South America, which lasted for 39 dates between February and October 2015.

What a great time we had in Montreal last night great show great audience lot of fun peace and love??????

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) October 23, 2015

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, percussion
